[[File:Senate_Defense_Committee.png|thumb|right|250px|The Senate Defense Committee]]
The '''Senate Defense Committee''' was led by three [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|senators]] - [[Voralla]], [[Arnus]], and [[Zorin Krasul]]. When the [[Havoc Squad]] defected to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], they summoned its only remaining member for questioning. They asked about why the members would defect and let slip that it could be related to something Republic did on [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]]. They then let the new Havoc Squad go, though Senator Krasul was later kidnapped by [[Zora|one of the defectors]] soon after.
